Metadata.title: Sanad | Customer service & support ERP
Metadata.description: A multi-tenant SaaS platform for support tickets, SLAs, CRM, field operations and knowledge. Arabic-first with a complete English experience.

hero.description: Tickets, SLAs, customers, assets and work orders in one workspace. Sanad gives support teams full context instead of ten disconnected tools.
hero.note: 14 days free · No credit card · Set up in minutes

preview.ticketOne: Unable to sign in to the customer portal

features.title: One foundation for support and operations.
features.description: No separate helpdesk, CRM and maintenance system. Sanad is designed around the customer, the ticket and the asset.

context.title: A true 360° customer view
context.description: Contacts, contracts, assets, tickets and invoices in one place while the conversation is happening.

sla.title: SLAs nothing slips through
sla.description: First-response and resolution targets by priority, business calendars, pauses and a clear breach trail.

operations.title: From ticket to work order
operations.description: Create a work order, connect the asset and warranty, then issue a quotation or service invoice.

collaboration.title: Collaboration without noise
collaboration.description: Private notes, teammate mentions and canned responses keep team context away from the customer.

bilingual.title: Arabic-first, done properly
bilingual.description: A native RTL interface plus a complete English experience, not just translated labels.

security.title: Isolation and security by default
security.description: Every company has a separate workspace, permission-based roles and an audit trail for important events.

workflow.title: Context that carries from message to closure.
workflow.description: Each step builds on the last without re-entering the same data.

one.title: Receive the ticket
one.description: From the portal, email or chat, with priority, department and SLA assigned automatically.

two.title: Understand customer and asset
two.description: Open the customer, asset, warranty and contract while solving the issue.

three.title: Do the work
three.description: Dispatch a technician, request parts, keep internal notes and commit to clear dates.

four.title: Close and measure
four.description: Record the resolution, collect CSAT and issue a service invoice when needed.

trial.question: Does the free trial require a credit card?
trial.answer: No. You get a complete workspace for 14 days without a card. The plan you choose is recorded at signup and your data stays yours.

lang.question: Can we use the platform in English?
lang.answer: Yes. Arabic is the primary language with a native RTL interface, and every user can switch to English LTR at any time. Knowledge-base content supports both languages.

isolation.question: How is each company's data isolated?
isolation.answer: Every operational record is linked to a tenantId, and business identifiers are unique inside the tenant only. Access requires an active workspace membership, and permissions are enforced on the server.

roles.question: Can roles be customized?
roles.answer: Yes. Five system roles are included — owner, admin, agent, technician and billing manager — and each tenant can create custom roles with selected permissions.

data.question: Do I lose my data when the trial ends?
data.answer: Your workspace data remains stored. The trial converts to a paid subscription when billing is activated, and data is not deleted automatically when the trial ends.

cta.title: Bring your team into one support workspace.
cta.description: Create an isolated workspace, get default departments and SLAs, and start in minutes.

footer.tagline: The support and operations platform for Arabic teams.

Pricing.title: Pricing that fits your stage.
Pricing.description: Start with a 14-day trial on any plan. Prices are in USD and you can change plans as you grow.
Pricing.footnote: Prices exclude applicable taxes. Subscriptions and invoices are managed from workspace settings.
